name: io.github.tonyyang0504/shopee-mcp
description: Shopee (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped, set_inventory, update_listing, end_listi

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_PARTNER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: partner_key (live key) of the app; signs the token refresh and every shop call (HMAC-SHA256). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: refresh_token from GetAccessToken (/api/v2/auth/token/get) after the shop authorised the app (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20). Valid 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_PARTNER_ID
environmentVariables.description: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: shop_id of the authorised shop (returned in the authorisation redirect).
